title: MODEL_LIST
description: JSON schema for the MODEL_LIST environment variable. MODEL_LIST must be a JSON array string whose parsed value matches this schema.

id.description: The exact model identifier sent to the upstream OpenAI-compatible API.

name.description: Display name shown in the UI.

provider.description: UI-only provider/group identifier. Does not control routing.

description.description: Optional model description for the selector UI.

tools.description: Whether the model supports tool calling.

vision.description: Whether the model supports image inputs.

reasoning.description: Whether the model should be treated as a reasoning model in app behavior/UI.

structuredOutputs.description: Whether the model/provider combination is suitable for structured outputs.

providerOptions.description: Optional provider-specific request options injected into providerOptions.<providerNameCamelCase>.
